prediction.tcp_ring: L3 keeps all N streams of each fixed source/destination pair on one uplink; L4 gives 1-flow no choice, 4 flows can remain lumpy (E1 saw 50/50 to about 75/25), and 16 flows should tend closer to even.
prediction.tcp_all_to_all: Different IP pairs can hash onto different paths even with L3; within each pair, L3 still cannot distinguish parallel streams. L4 should improve aggregate sharing as N grows, but is not predicted to guarantee an even split.
prediction.soft_roce: The two VM endpoints allow parallel QPs; L3 should keep fixed-IP QP traffic on one spine, while L4 may spread UDP source ports. Perftest exposes aggregate bandwidth; its equal-share per-QP number is a derived mean, not a directly measured per-QP rate.

method.perfect_split_definition: counter-derived equal split across active leaf ECMP uplinks; ideal job time = observed slowest-flow completion / worst active-leaf max/mean byte ratio
